response.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_averages) SELECT AVG(ia.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(ia.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(ia.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_above_overall FROM invoice_averages AS ia CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ia.ratio > o.average_ratio;
